note: Literature confirms SCAF4 variants cause Fliedner-Zweier syndrome with variable penetrance of seizures and neurodevelopmental features across cohorts.

evidence.text: In the initial characterization of the SCAF4-associated neurodevelopmental disorder, seizures occurred in four individuals (50%), and affected individuals showed variable neurodevelopmental and structural manifestations.

source.title: Variants in SCAF4 Cause a Neurodevelopmental Disorder ...
source.quote: Seizures occurred in four individuals (50%) and included myoclonic seizures in two and intractable seizures in one. Brain MRIs were performed ...

evidence.text: An expanded cohort of 50 individuals confirmed that frequent findings include mild developmental delay with speech impairment, seizures, and skeletal abnormalities, with variable phenotypic severity.

source.title: Further delineation of the SCAF4-associated neurodevelopmental disorder
source.quote: Frequent clinical findings were mild developmental delay with speech impairment, seizures, and skeletal abnormalities such as clubfoot, scoliosis or hip dysplasia.
